scientific_scope: score-conditioned fixed shortlist from a previously closed single-seed author A/B pair; no new inference or causal decomposition

shortlist.k_per_image: min(count of nonempty native masks in A, count of nonempty native masks in B)
shortlist.order: filter empty RLE masks and take first k in original native per-image order, preserving ties and including images with k=0

coverage.comparison: original 800x800 raster mask IoU with inclusive threshold; score-blind maximum-cardinality matching per image and threshold on the fixed shortlist
coverage.matching: SciPy 1.15.3 maximum_bipartite_matching with lexicographic RLE candidate counts and numeric GT ID order; no score or secondary IoU objective after shortlist
coverage.size_partition: official annotation area, small <1024, medium [1024,9216), large >=9216; tabulate a single image-global assignment at each threshold and retain exact area-boundary census

score_templates.cells: A masks/B masks crossed with A/B original ranked score donors at corresponding image and rank; boxes excluded
score_templates.checks: same donor has identical COCO score-rank layout across candidate masks; same candidate masks have identical within-image matching and recalls across donors
score_templates.reported: four cells full COCO summaries and AP90 with four directional differences; original primary and empty-sensitivity endpoint APs separately
